intro: In southwestern Elwynn Forest, Hogger leads the Riverpaw gnolls in raids on farms and travelers. His violent attacks have earned him a bounty from the Stormwind Marshals.

p: Hogger commands the Riverpaw pack from Hogger Hill in southwestern Elwynn Forest. Since the Third War, the gnolls have grown bolder and more coordinated in their raids on nearby homesteads. The Riverpaw have joined forces with the Defias Brotherhood, exchanging their raw ferocity for arms, tactical direction, and magical support. To protect Elwynn's borders and trade routes from further bloodshed, Marshal Dughan has posted a bounty on Hogger's head.
